reason: Rails allocates a `Concurrent::Array.new` (core.rb:220); JS has no concurrent-array class and the single-threaded event loop needs none, so the stack is a plain `[]`.

Rails `include mod` mixes a generated Module into the class (core.rb:341); trails has no generated module — `generatedAssociationMethods` is a Set of generated method names — so there is nothing to include.

TS language shortcoming: Rails' `hash[:klasses].include?(Base)` (core.rb:206) names Base, but core.ts is imported *by* base.ts, so the constant cannot be referenced here; the arm is spelled `klasses.some(isBase)` against the own `_isActiveRecordBase` brand.
